text: dsh-locale-fr 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的法语语言包，通过客户端 locale 服务注册法语词典，并在旧版接口下提供查询回退；对两个第三方插件的部分中文界面文字，还可按已知词条替换显示内容。它覆盖侧栏、聊天、命令菜单、执行过程和设置等界面文本，未翻译词条沿用英文。适合希望以法语使用 DSH 网页界面的用户。安装到 web profile 即可，无需 API 密钥或额外外部服务。

dsh-locale-fr adds French to the DSH web interface. It registers dictionaries through the locale service and supports older versions with a lookup fallback. It also translates known Chinese labels from two community plugins. Untranslated entries fall back to English. No API key is needed.
想把 DSH 网页界面切换成法语。
DSH 的菜单和设置只有英文或中文吗？我需要法语界面。
I want to use the DSH browser interface in French.
dsh-locale-fr 的功能「法语界面词典」：向 DSH locale 服务逐命名空间注册法语词典，并添加法语语言选项；旧版服务则通过 lookup 回退提供法语文本。插件随 web profile 加载。
dsh-locale-fr feature “French labels”: it replaces known Chinese labels from two community plugins in the web page.

dsh-locale-fr README · dsh-locale-fr — French for the DeepSeek Harness web UI：A language pack for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) (`dsh`).
It puts the browser UI in **French**: sidebar, composer, command menu, execution trail,
settings and every section of them — **1163 strings across 33 namespaces**.

It ships a second, separable layer that translates two community plugins which hard-code
their Chinese labels (see [Third-party layer](#third-party-layer)).

section: dsh-locale-fr — French for the DeepSeek Harness web UI

text:
dsh-locale-fr README · Why this exists：dsh ships `zh` and `en` only. That is a shipping choice, **not an architectural limit**:
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale` exposes a real extension point.

dsh-locale-fr README · Why this exists：- **dsh 0.1.2-rc.1 and later** — `ctx.locale.addLanguage({ id, label, fallback })` accepts any
  BCP 47-ish tag whose fallback chain terminates at `en`. The pack registers `fr`, and
  **Français shows up in Settings → General → Language** with no UI change at all. The choice
  persists in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` as `locale.preference: fr`.
- **dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 and earlier** — the catalog is frozen to `zh`/`en` and `setLocale("fr")`
  throws. The pack then patches the single function that reads a string,
  `lookup(namespace, key)`, to consult French first. Same result, one caveat: French is
  **always** active, since there is no catalog entry to switch away from. Remove the plugin to
  get English back.

dsh-locale-fr README · Why this exists：The pack detects which case it is in. Nothing to configure.

An untranslated key **always falls back to English**, never to Chinese.
dsh-locale-fr README · Install：```bash
dsh-locale-fr README · from a checkout：dsh plugin --profile web add "link:/path/to/dsh-locale-fr"

dsh-locale-fr README · or straight from git：dsh plugin --profile web add "github:GaaaorkOrga/dsh-locale-fr"
```

Web profile only — it is a browser-side plugin, and it mounts itself through its own
`cordis.patch.yml`, so `headless` and `tui` profiles never reference it and start without it.
yaml

dsh-locale-fr README · ~/.dsh/settings.yaml：locale:
  preference: fr
```

**No file under `node_modules` is ever modified.** A dsh update cannot wipe the translation.

dsh-locale-fr README · How it is built：`dictionaries/fr.json` is the single source of truth. `lib/client.js` is **generated** from it —
never edit the generated file. The generator is the Rust tool `dfr` (`crates/dfr-outils`; the
browser module itself is the template `templates/client.js.tpl`, browser code that dsh requires
to be JavaScript):

```bash
cargo build --release   # once
target/release/dfr build-client
```

dsh-locale-fr README · Adding or fixing a string：Edit `dictionaries/fr.json`, rebuild, reload the page. Keys mirror the namespaces dsh
registers (`conversation`, `chat`, `trajectory`, `settings.models`, …).

Placeholders in braces — `{count}`, `{toolName}`, `{command}` — are part of the contract and
must be copied verbatim, spelling included.

dsh-locale-fr README · Refreshing after a dsh upgrade：A new dsh release adds strings. They show in English until you harvest and translate them:

```bash

dsh-locale-fr README · 1. Harvest the English dictionaries from the dsh you actually RUN：dfr harvest-dictionaries \
  ~/.npm/_npx/<hash>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai  english.json
section: 1. Harvest the English dictionaries from the dsh you actually RUN

text:
dsh-locale-fr README · 3. Rebuild：dfr build-client
```

Harvest from the version you **run**, not from whatever happens to sit in a cache — namespaces
and keys move between releases. That mistake cost a debugging round here.

dsh-locale-fr README · Porting to another language：Nothing in the machinery is French-specific:

1. Copy `dictionaries/fr.json` to `dictionaries/<lang>.json` and translate the values.
2. In `templates/client.js.tpl`, change `LANGUAGE` (`id`, `label` in its own language, `fallback`)
   and the `"fr"` passed to `locale.register`.
3. Rebuild, install, done.

Pull requests adding a language are welcome — say so in the issue first so we can agree on
whether it lives here or in a sibling package.

dsh-locale-fr README · Third-party layer：`@welsione/dsh-model-router` (0.0.8) and `dsh-model-selector` (0.5.0) never call `ctx.locale`:
every label is a string literal. **No language pack, in any language, can reach them** — it is
an integration gap, not a translation gap. The router's whole settings page stays Chinese, and
the model chip's label is visible on every screen.

dsh-locale-fr README · Third-party layer：`dictionaries/third-party-fr.json` holds **575 Chinese fragments** and their French, applied by a
`MutationObserver` on what is displayed. Fragments, not sentences: those plugins assemble their
labels at runtime.

Guard rails:

dsh-locale-fr README · Third-party layer：**This layer is a stopgap.** Upstream requests are filed —
[welsione/dsh-model-router#1](https://github.com/welsione/dsh-model-router/issues/1),
[DeepVite/dsh-model-selector#1](https://github.com/DeepVite/dsh-model-selector/issues/1) — and
it should be deleted as soon as either lands. To disable it now, empty the file:

```bash
echo '{}' > dictionaries/third-party-fr.json && dfr build-client
```

To regenerate it for a newer plugin version:

dsh-locale-fr README · Third-party layer：```bash
dfr harvest-cjk \
  ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@welsione/dsh-model-router/lib/client.js \
  ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-model-selector/lib/client/index.js > runs.json
```

dsh-locale-fr README · Known gaps：Out of reach of any language pack, because they do not go through the locale registry:

- **Slash-command descriptions** (`/compact`, `/export`, …) — served by the host.
- **Access-mode names** (Read Only / Workspace Write / Full access) — rendered from host
  identifiers.

dsh-locale-fr README · A word about dsh versions：`latest` moved from `0.1.1-rc.2` to `0.1.2-rc.1` on 2026-09-04. That release drops
`settingsNamespace` and `installSettingsSection` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`, which
`dsh-model-selector` and `@welsione/dsh-model-router` still import. The plugin loader
aggregates the failures and **dsh refuses to start** — it does not merely skip the two plugins.
Unrelated to this pack, but you will meet it if you run those plugins; pin your dsh version
until they catch up.

dsh-locale-fr README · Contributing：Issues and pull requests welcome — translation fixes, other languages, or taking over
maintenance. Code comments are in English; the dictionaries are plain JSON, no build chain
beyond `cargo build --release` (the `dfr` tool).

dsh-locale-fr README · En français：Ce paquet met l'interface web de DeepSeek Harness en français : 1163 étiquettes réparties en
33 familles de textes. dsh ne livre que le chinois et l'anglais, mais son registre de langues
prévoit officiellement des langues supplémentaires — ce paquet s'y branche, sans modifier un
seul fichier livré par l'éditeur.

dsh-locale-fr README · En français：- **Installation** : `dsh plugin --profile web add "github:GaaaorkOrga/dsh-locale-fr"`, puis
  choisir **Français** dans Réglages → Général → Langue (dsh 0.1.2+). Sur une version
  antérieure, le français s'applique tout seul.
- **Corriger un mot** : éditer `dictionaries/fr.json`, relancer `dfr build-client` (outil Rust, voir plus haut),
  recharger la page. `lib/client.js` est engendré — ne jamais l'éditer à la main.
- **Une étiquette non traduite** retombe en anglais, jamais en chinois.
- Une seconde couche traduit l'affichage de deux modules communautaires qui écrivent leurs
  libellés chinois en dur, hors du système de langues. Elle est provisoire : deux demandes ont
  été déposées auprès de leurs auteurs.
dsh-locale-fr README · En français：Contributions bienvenues, y compris pour d'autres langues ou pour reprendre la maintenance.
